title: Top Simply XML Alternatives, Competitors
summary: A comparison article lists Paligo, Componize Software, and XMetaL as top alternatives to Simply XML, highlighting their CCMS and structured authoring capabilities. title: Documentation as Code: A Complete Guide for 2026 — GitDoc
summary: GitDoc published a 15‑minute guide called “Documentation as Code: A Complete Guide for 2026,” outlining the what, why, and how of treating docs as code. It shows technical writers how to use Git, Markdown/AsciiDoc, pull‑requests and CI/CD to keep documentation in sync with software, improving traceability, release safety, and reducing doc rot.

title: Automate your documentation with your CI/CD pipeline (Documentation As Code)
summary: The article provides a TravisCI pipeline that installs MkDocs, builds the site, packages it in a Docker image, and pushes it to a registry. This demonstrates how documentation can be treated as code, enabling teams to automate builds, enforce consistency, and include docs in the Definition of Done.
